title: Independence of Rademacher summands
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and choose real coefficients $a_1,\ldots,a_n$. Under the uniform probability measure on $\{-1,1\}^n$, the random variables $x\mapsto a_i x_i$, for $i=1,\ldots,n$, are mutually independent.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is any real coefficient vector of length $n$
the underlying measure is uniform on the sign cube
